description: Explore the physical world around you with an Earth Science minor from the University of Central Missouri. Spanning multiple disciplines, earth science takes a broad, investigative approach to the “how” and “why” of Earth's scientific processes. As an Earth Science minor at UCM, you'll apply knowledge and tools from all areas of science and math to better understand how the earth works. Research labs and class projects will provide opportunities to develop investigative and communication skills that complement a variety of undergraduate majors — and are valuable in many career industries. [3] UCM's Earth Science minor starts with the foundational course, Introduction to Geology, to help you better understand earth's systems. You'll build on the fundamental principles learned in this course and others as you progress through the program. You can also choose from a variety of electives to complete your Earth Science minor. [3] In the Speech Communication and Theatre program at UCM, you'll get a time-tested education from decades of experience. [3] We continue to evolve our practices to meet the needs of future educators. [3] All of our classes are available on our Warrensburg campus for the traditional college experience, but you may also choose to take some classes online for flexible options in completing your minor along with your bachelor's degree. [3] The result is expanded knowledge and skills that enhance your value to high school administrators. [3] You'll study acting, directing and stagecraft, as well as communication theory and speech and debate, so you'll know how to teach your future students all these aspects. [3]
